retrievalProfile.description: A high-key monochrome close-up portrait featuring a central subject framed by raised arms, with bottom-right justified stylized typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, grainy black-and-white headshot of a person looking directly at the camera, framed by their own arms. The lighting is bright and soft, creating a high-key effect that washes out the background into pure white. Typography is clustered in the bottom right corner, mixing clean sans-serif with decorative, elongated swashes.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's face acts as the primary focal point, centered horizontally.
Raised arms create a natural frame around the head, leading the eye inward.
High-contrast black and white tones separate the subject from the blown-out background.
Typography is anchored to the bottom right, balancing the visual weight of the subject's shoulder.
coreInvariants: Monochrome color palette with visible film grain texture.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, head centered vertically and horizontally, filling approximately 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, positioned slightly above the horizontal midline.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the eyes, the gaze moves down to the lips, then follows the curve of the arms to the typography in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant pure white negative space in the upper corners and background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Mid-tone grays in the skin and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep black in the hair, eyes, and clothing.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value range with compressed mid-tones for a soft, luminous look.

letterConstructionRules: Exaggerated circular swashes on terminal characters
Tight letter spacing for the main title
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'E' and 'L' characters feature elongated, looping tails that extend below the baseline.
The 'S' is integrated into the flow of the surrounding swashes.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A clean, wide-tracked sans-serif paired with a heavily stylized, custom-swash version of the same weight.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the clean geometric skeleton for the base text.
Matches the geometric aesthetic and historical context of stylized ligatures.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key, grainy black and white close-up portrait of a person looking forward, framed by their arms raised above their head. The background should be blown out to pure white.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add right-aligned white text in the bottom right corner. Use a clean geometric sans-serif for the top line with wide tracking. For the bottom line, use a larger font with custom vector swashes looping from the 'E' and 'L' characters.

verificationChecks: Is the text right-aligned in the bottom corner?
Do the letters have decorative swashes?

postGenerationChecks: Check for high-key exposure without losing facial detail.
Ensure film grain is uniform across the subject.
Verify that swashes do not obscure legibility.
Confirm the composition remains bottom-right heavy for text.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key monochrome portrait + geometric sans-serif + custom vector swashes + bottom-right justification.
